summary.text: Andrew Georgevits is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Georgevits was the Republican candidate for Merrimack 23 in 2024, when incumbent Merryl Gibbs, a Democrat, defeated him 53.0% to 47.0%.
In the November 4, 2025 Concord City Council Ward 9 election he ran as a nonpartisan candidate and lost to incumbent Kris Schultz.
